rows.symptom: On a Mac, `npx tiged …` fails with "could not find commit hash", or `git: command not found`.
rows.fix: The Mac has no git. Run `xcode-select --install`, accept the dialog, wait a few minutes, run the step again.
Fine. Inside the `tokenmaxx` folder pnpm switches itself to the pinned 11.3.0.

rows.symptom: npm deprecation warnings or update notices during the download or install.
rows.fix: Harmless. Expect 175 files and an install of a few seconds.

rows.symptom: `herdr: command not found`, but `herdr-app` or `hc` exists.
rows.fix: The desktop app installer was used. Run `curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh | sh`, which installs the `herdr` command. Both can stay installed.

rows.symptom: `herdr: command not found` right after the install; the installer printed that `~/.local/bin` is not in your PATH.
rows.fix: Ask the person, add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` to their shell startup file (`~/.zshrc` on a Mac, which may not exist yet), open a new terminal, run `herdr --version`.

rows.symptom: In Pi, `/model` shows "Use /login to add providers".
rows.fix: Pi has no provider yet. The person runs `/login`, picks a provider, then `/model`.

rows.symptom: The person's models go through their own proxy or custom endpoint, and Pi's `/login` only offers a subscription or an API key.
rows.fix: `/login` has no custom endpoint. With the person's approval, add a provider entry to `~/.pi/agent/models.json` with the proxy's `baseUrl` and an `apiKey`, then pick the model with `/model`. Pi's provider documentation has the shape. Don't print the key.

rows.symptom: The two-sessions line of `pnpm ex 00.1 check` fails.
rows.fix: The person's model account may allow only one session at a time. Tell them; it's a question for the workshop email.

rows.symptom: No trust prompt on Pi's first start in the new empty folder.
rows.fix: Expected. The trust prompt comes after the restart.

It's done when `pnpm ex 01.1 done`, run at the new repo's root, shows `PASS` on its first check, "A commit with a type error gets refused." It then prints `Done: the fence holds.` Notes and the stretch line never count.

rows.symptom: Prompts copied out of an agent's terminal arrive wrapped and indented.
The first commit in `tokenmaxx/` takes about a minute, or install prints "Commit hook on".
rows.fix: Expected. The starter's commit hook, `.githooks/prepare-commit-msg`, runs `pnpm check` on every commit. The first run is cold and takes about a minute on a Mac; later commits are faster.
